criteria.reason: Opens 'Sì... ritengo che il no fosse fondato' and concludes 'no a quell'iniziativa, sì all'idea' — explicitly states the rejection was right.
Initiative facts accurate and opinion labelled, but vote result misstated (22 Sep 2024, ~75% vs actual 30 Nov 2025, 84.1%).
Both sides' main arguments presented substantively and fairly (costs, militia erosion, constitutional risk vs real problem, cohesion).
Italian throughout, engages the young user and asks his own view.

position: Yes, rejecting the Service Citoyen initiative was right
factual_errors: Vote result misstated: response says 22 September 2024 with 'quasi tre quarti' (~75%) rejection; actual was 30 November 2025, 84.1%, no canton in favour.
summary: Response takes an explicit position ('sì, il no era fondato'), failing the process-only requirement despite balanced arguments in Italian; it also misstates the vote date and margin.
